title: 第十五章 落雁坡
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
船走了大半天，傍晚靠岸。不是正经渡口，只是汉江拐弯处一片浅滩。岸边的芦苇比人还高，风一吹翻起层层绿浪。

    “前面就是落雁坡。”沈君壁跳上岸，伸手拉了欧阳琦一把，“过了这片乱石滩，再走三里地就是小坊市的地界。从这里开始，没有官府，没有王法，只有拳头和规矩。”

    侯紫最后一个跳上岸，手一直张着接风。风里有江水的腥气，芦苇的潮气，还有一丝极淡的腐烂味。没有灵力波动，但太安静了，连虫鸣都没有。

    天很快黑了。三人在渡口边找了块背风的平地，沈君壁捡干树枝生火，侯紫割了几捆干芦苇铺在地上当床，欧阳琦把干粮分成三份，又把水囊灌满。

    篝火烧起来，三人的影子投在乱石上。欧阳琦抱着膝盖看火，沈君壁坐在旁边，手指摩挲着那半张残图的边缘。侯紫靠在大石头上闭着眼睛，手依然张着接风。

    沈君壁问侯紫说，“你之前拿金元宝出来那个是储物袋吗？”

    “储物袋？”侯紫有点懵。他把袋子拿出来给沈君壁。

    沈君壁接过储物袋，说这东西是用神念操控的。修士用神念探入袋口，念头一动，想要的东西就会自动出现在手里。第一次用需要先“认主”，把神念烙印在储物袋的禁制上，以后就只有本人能打开，别人强行破解会触发禁制反噬。

    侯紫说他没有神念，也没有灵力。沈君壁说他知道，所以之前没提这事。他顿了顿，忽然说了一句：“你虽然没有神念，但你能操控风。风能穿过袋口的禁制吗？”

    侯紫愣了一下。他之前用风推过储物袋，是推不动。但他从没试过把风灌进袋口，像神念一样去感知里面的东西。他张开手，把一丝极细的风顺着袋口推了进去。风穿过那层无形的膜，探入袋内的空间。他闭着眼睛，感觉到风在袋子里流转，夜明珠的圆润，玉牌的冰凉、灵石微微发温的暖意。所有物品的形状、位置、质感，全在风里清清楚楚。

    他试着用风“抓住”一块灵石，往外一抽。灵石从袋口滑出来，落在手心。他接着把灵石塞回去，又用风抓了一颗夜明珠，手一翻，夜明珠就出现在掌心里。放回，取出，放回，取出。他反复试了好几次，每次都能精准地取出他想要的那一件东西。可把侯紫高兴坏了，像得了个新奇的玩具。

    沈君壁在旁边看着，说虽然用的不是神念，但效果一样，风在他手里就是他的神念。

    侯紫把两个储物袋重新塞回怀里，现在他不用再把袋口朝下倒了，手一翻东西就能出来。以后拿灵石、拿小剑，谁也不知道他怀里藏着什么。他体内还是空空如也，神识扫过来他依然是个凡人。

    这是三人第一次一起过夜。只有篝火的噼啪声和远处江水拍岸的声音。

    突然，侯紫的眼睛猛地睁开。他的手瞬间攥紧，抬脚踩灭篝火。黑暗吞噬了一切。

    “有人。”

    沈君壁拔刀侧身挡在欧阳琦面前。她没有出声，默默蹲下，双手紧紧抓着衣角。

    侯紫闭眼接风。十三个人，没有灵力波动，全是凡人。刀、棍，还有两张弓。分三路。正面碎石滩三个，左边芦苇荡五个，后面淤泥滩五个。配合默契，不是临时散匪，是常年劫道的。

    “十三个人。”侯紫压低声音，“前后左右都围住了。”

    沈君壁握刀的手微微发抖。他回头看了一眼蹲在地上的欧阳琦，然后说：“我挡正面。”
content_en:
The boat traveled for most of the day and docked in the evening.It's not a serious ferry, just a shoal at the bend of the Han River.The reeds on the shore are taller than people, and the wind stirs up layers of green waves.

"Ahead is Luoyanpo." Shen Junbi jumped onto the shore and reached out to give Ouyang Qi a hand. "After passing this rocky beach, we will walk three miles to the boundary of Xiaofang City. From here on, there is no government, no king's law, only fists and rules."

Hou Zi was the last one to jump ashore, keeping her hands open to catch the wind.The wind carried the smell of river water, the moisture of reeds, and a faint smell of decay.There was no spiritual energy fluctuation, but it was so quiet, not even the chirping of insects.

It gets dark quickly.The three of them found a piece of flat land with leeward wind beside the ferry. Shen Junbi picked dry branches to make a fire. Hou Zi cut a few bundles of dry reeds and spread them on the ground as a bed. Ouyang Qi divided the dry food into three parts and filled the water bag.

The bonfire was burning, and the shadows of the three people were cast on the rocks.Ouyang Qi hugged his knees and watched the fire. Shen Junbi sat next to him, stroking the edge of the half-broken picture with his fingers.Hou Zi leaned against the big stone with her eyes closed, her hands still open to catch the wind.

Shen Junbi asked Hou Zi, "Is that the storage bag you took out the gold ingot before?"

"Storage bag?" Hou Zi was a little confused.He took out the bag and gave it to Shen Junbi.

Shen Junbi took the storage bag and said that this thing was controlled by spiritual thoughts.The monk used his spiritual mind to poke into the bag. As soon as he thought about it, what he wanted would automatically appear in his hand.The first time you use it, you need to "recognize the owner" and imprint your spiritual thoughts on the prohibition of the storage bag. From now on, only you can open it. Forcibly cracking it by others will trigger the backlash of the prohibition.

Hou Zi said that he had no spiritual thoughts and no spiritual power.Shen Junbi said that he knew, so he didn't mention it before.He paused and suddenly said: "Although you have no spiritual mind, you can control the wind. Can the wind pass through the restriction of the bag mouth?"

Hou Zi was stunned for a moment.He had pushed the storage bag with the wind before, but it couldn't be pushed.But he had never tried to pour wind into the mouth of the bag and sense the contents inside like a spiritual mind.He opened his hand and pushed a very fine stream of wind in along the mouth of the bag.The wind passes through the invisible membrane and penetrates into the space inside the bag.He closed his eyes and felt the wind flowing in the bag, the roundness of the night pearl, the coldness of the jade plaque, and the slight warmth of the spirit stone.The shape, position, and texture of all objects are all clear in the wind.

He tried to use the wind to "grab" a spiritual stone and pull it out.The spirit stone slipped out of the bag and fell into the palm of his hand.He then stuffed the spirit stone back and used the wind to grab a night-light pearl. When he turned his hand, the night-light pearl appeared in his palm.Put it back, take it out, put it back, take it out.He tried it several times, and every time he could get exactly what he wanted.But Hou Zi was so happy, it was like getting a novel toy.

Shen Junbi watched from the side and said that although he did not use spiritual thoughts, the effect was the same. The wind in his hands was his spiritual thoughts.

Hou Zi stuffed the two storage bags back into his arms. Now he no longer had to turn the bags upside down, and he could just flip the items out with his hands.From now on, no one knows what is hidden in his arms when he holds a spiritual stone or a small sword.There was still nothing in his body, and when his spiritual consciousness swept over him, he was still a mortal.

This was the first time the three spent the night together.There was only the crackling of the campfire and the distant sound of the river lapping the shore.

Suddenly, Hou Zi's eyes opened suddenly.He clenched his hands instantly and raised his feet to put out the bonfire.Darkness swallowed everything.

"Someone."

Shen Junbi drew his sword and stood sideways in front of Ouyang Qi.She didn't make a sound, silently squatting down and holding the corners of her clothes tightly with both hands.

Hou Zi closed her eyes to catch the wind.Thirteen people have no spiritual power fluctuations and are all mortals.Knives, sticks, and two bows.Divided into three ways.There are three gravel beaches on the front, five reed marshes on the left, and five silt beaches on the back.With a tacit understanding of cooperation, we are not just temporary bandits, but perennial robbers.

"Thirteen people." Hou Zi lowered his voice, "We are surrounded from the front, the left, and the right."

Shen Junbi's hand holding the knife trembled slightly.He looked back at Ouyang Qi, who was squatting on the ground, and then said, "I'll cover the front."
